tools.name: copy_template_sheet
tools.description: FIRST step for a new merchant who does not have a product sheet yet: navigates this page to Google’s "Make a copy" screen for the SpreadFront product-sheet template, so one click puts the template into the user’s own Google Drive (SpreadFront never gets Drive access - the copy happens entirely on Google’s side). Use start_free_store instead when the user already has a product sheet or only wants to sign in. Call WITHOUT confirm first for a no-side-effect preview; call with confirm: true (after the user agrees) to actually navigate. Returns JSON: {preview, navigatingTo, agentInstructions: string[] (ordered steps for YOU, the agent, to carry through after this page and its tools are gone - read and keep them), note}.

confirm.description: true = actually navigate (do this only after the user agreed). false/omitted = preview: returns what would happen, navigates nowhere.

tools.name: get_plans_and_pricing
tools.description: SpreadFront subscription plans with prices in EUR and USD, limits and included features. Filter to one plan and/or one currency, or omit both for the full table. Free plan is free forever; paid plans bill annually with a 14-day trial plus a 14-day refund window. Returns JSON: {plans: [{name, priceMonthly: {eur?, usd?}, priceYearly: {eur?, usd?}, billing, limits: {stores, productsPerStore, ordersPerMonth, storage}, highlights[], notIncluded[]}], payments: string, currency?: string}.

plan.description: Return only this plan. Omit for all three.

currency.description: Return prices only in this currency. Omit for both.

tools.name: get_spreadfront_info
tools.description: Information about the SpreadFront platform (turn a Google Sheet into a hosted online store). Pick a topic to get just that section, or "all" for everything: overview (what it is, principles, signup + live demo store URL), how_it_works (3-step setup), agentic_commerce (how stores support AI agents), payments (how merchants get paid, 0% commission), docs (guide/manual/terms links). Returns JSON with the requested sections: {topic, product?: {name, url, what, signupUrl, demoStoreUrl, principles[]}, howItWorks?: string[], agentic?: string, payments?: string, docs?: {guide, manual, terms, refunds}}.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the SpreadFront documentation (the merchant manual and the setup guide) for how a feature works: sheet columns, payments, subscriptions, digital products, custom domains, shipping, coupons, languages, agentic commerce and more. Returns JSON: {totalMatches, results: [{heading, excerpt, page (URL of the docs page)}]}.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "subscription products", "custom domain SSL", "options variants column".

tools.name: start_free_store
tools.description: The sign-in step: navigate this page to the SpreadFront sign-in so the human can create their free account and store. Use when the user already has a product sheet or just wants an account; use copy_template_sheet first when they still need the product-sheet template. This action does NOT create an account - account creation always requires the human (Google sign-in or a confirmed email link); there is deliberately no automated signup. Call WITHOUT confirm first for a no-side-effect preview; call with confirm: true (after the user agrees) to actually navigate. Returns JSON: {preview, navigatingTo, note, nextSteps: string[]}.

confirm.description: true = actually navigate (do this only after the user agreed). false/omitted = preview: returns what would happen, navigates nowhere.
